pages.title: Bridging Two Clusters
pages.text: Two separate Living Chest clusters stay separate, even if you'd like them to act as one - unless a chain of Storage Connectors physically links them together. A Connector contributes no slots of its own; it's purely a bridge, and doesn't require the Storage System skill to craft.

pages.title: Ownership Conflicts
pages.text: You can't bridge two clusters that already each have their own claimed Terminal - the game rejects the placement outright rather than silently merging two owners' storage together. Bridge clusters before claiming them with a Terminal, or keep unclaimed chests on one side of the connector.
